## Interface

- [Debug Console](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/interface/debug-console.md): Because CommandPost is powered by a huge collection of Lua scripts, the Debug Console is one of the most important places in CommandPost to track down bugs and issues.
- [Menubar](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/interface/menubar.md): The main interface for CommandPost is the menubar, which sits in your system’s menubar at the top right of the screen alongside other items such as the WiFi icon, Volume Control, Battery Information, Date & Time, and Spotlight.
- [Prevent Mac from Sleeping](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/interface/prevent-mac-from-sleeping.md): Much like the beloved MacOS app Caffeine, CommandPost provides an option to prevent your Mac from automatically going to sleep. This setting overrides your Battery setting in your System Preferences and keeps the display on indefinitely.
- [Search Console](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/interface/search-console.md): The Search Console is a name for the interface we use for selection actions in CommandPost. It's very similar to macOS Spotlight.
- [Sending Apple Feedback](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/interface/sending-apple-feedback.md): This feature allows you to access the offical Apple "Provide Final Cut Pro Feedback" website, but pre-populates a lot of the text boxes for faster access.

## Preferences

- [General](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/preferences/general.md): The General settings pane of CommandPost is a section of the app's settings where you can configure various settings related to the app itself. These settings include options for controlling the app's behavior, appearance, and functionality.
- [Finder](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/preferences/finder.md): The Finder section in CommandPost settings contains options to change the default behavior of the Finder regarding external drives, chimes, and pasteboard.
- [Menubar](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/preferences/menubar.md): This preferences panel allows you to customise the CommandPost menubar item.
- [Notifications](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/preferences/notifications.md): This preferences panel allows you to set up notifications for when a Final Cut Pro export is complete.
- [Final Cut Pro](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/preferences/final-cut-pro.md): This preferences panel allows you to change various Final Cut Pro preferences.
- [After Effects](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/preferences/after-effects.md): The After Effects Preferences panel allows you to scan for Effects.
- [Scripting](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/preferences/scripting.md): The Scripting preferences panel allows you to enable/disable Command Line Support & AppleScript support.
- [Shortcuts](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/preferences/shortcuts.md): CommandPost can allow you to trigger any shortcuts that you have in the macOS Shortcuts application.
- [Plugins](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/preferences/plugins.md): CommandPost is made up of many Lua-based plugins, all contained within the CommandPost application bundle. Plugins could contain, for example, an
- [Settings](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/preferences/settings.md): In a future release of CommandPost we will have a proper import/export feature for settings.

## Control Surfaces

- [Keyboard](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/keyboard.md): The most common way of triggering actions in CommandPost is via shortcut keys on your keyboard.
- [Touch Bar](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/touchbar.md): There's both a Virtual Touch Bar, which displays a Touch Bar on your computer screen, and the ability to add custom items to both the virtual and physical Touch Bar.
- [Stream Deck](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/streamdeck.md): CommandPost currently supports the following Stream Deck devices:
- [Resolve](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/resolve.md): CommandPost allows full control over the DaVinci Resolve Speed Editor and DaVinci Resolve Editor Keyboard.
- [Monogram](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/monogram.md): CommandPost uses the official Monogram Creator API to allow users to control both legacy Palette modules and the latest Monogram modules, such as Orbiter.
- [Tangent](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/tangent.md): CommandPost offers native support of the entire range of Tangent's panels, including the Arc, Element, Wave & Wave2, Ripple, the Element-Vs iPad & Android app, and any future panels.
- [TourBox](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/tourbox.md): CommandPost has support for the original TourBox, TourBox Elite and TourBox Elite Plus.
- [Razer](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/razer.md): CommandPost has support for a huge variety of Razer devices:
- [MIDI](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/midi.md): CommandPost can be triggered by any MIDI device.
- [Loupedeck](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/loupedeck.md): There are two ways to interact with Loupedeck devices in CommandPost - native/direct support, and via a Loupedeck Plugin.
- [AudioSwift](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/audioswift.md): AudioSwift allows you to use your MacBook Pro Trackpad and Magic Trackpad as a control surface.
- [Gamepad](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/control-surfaces/gamepad.md): We are planning to add built-in Gamepad support in a future release.

## Toolbox

- [Intro](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/toolbox/intro.md): The toolbox is an evolving collection of handy utilities commissioned by members of the CommandPost community to do very specific tasks, generally related to XML processing.
- [Notion](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/toolbox/notion.md): This feature was removed in CommandPost v1.6.0.
- [Titles](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/toolbox/titles.md): This utility allows you update the titles within a FCPXML, based on new data from a CSV file. You can also Batch Process an entire folder. To do this, the FCPXML and CSV filenames need to be identical.
- [Shot Data](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/toolbox/shot-data.md): This feature was removed in CommandPost v1.6.0.
- [Auto Sequence](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/toolbox/auto-sequence.md): When you drag a Final Cut Pro Project to this Toolbox, we'll send a new Project back to Final Cut Pro with the clips sorted by timecode.
- [Titles to Keywords](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/toolbox/titles-to-keywords.md): CommandPost has as insanely powerful Toolbox called Titles to Keywords.
- [Sony Timecode Repair](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/toolbox/sony-timecode.md): Final Cut Pro currently doesn't correctly interpret timecode from certain Sony Cameras that are recording into an MP4 wrapper.

## Watch Folders

- [FCPXML Watch Folder](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/watch-folders/fcpxml.md): This feature allows you to recieve macOS notfications whenever a FCPXML file is added into any of the below watch folders.
- [Media Watch Folder](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/watch-folders/media.md): This feature allows you to recieve macOS notfications whenever supported files are added into any of the below watch folders.

## Final Cut Pro

- [Batch Export Active Timeline](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/final-cut-pro/batch-export-active-timeline.md): Batch Export Active Timeline is designed to work similar to exporting individual clips in Resolve for handing over graded clips for online editing. In
- [HUD](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/final-cut-pro/hud.md): The HUD stands for Heads Up Display and provides a whole range of handy tools within Final Cut Pro.
- [Local Pasteboard History](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/final-cut-pro/local-pasteboard-history.md): This feature is accessible from the CommandPost Menubar when Final Cut Pro is active:
- [Save Browser Contents to CSV](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/final-cut-pro/save-browser-contents-to-csv.md): This feature allows you to save the entire text contents of your Final Cut Pro Browser to a CSV file.
- [Save Timeline Index to CSV](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/final-cut-pro/save-timeline-index-to-csv.md): This feature allows you to save the entire text contents of your Timeline Index to a CSV file.
- [Scrolling Timeline](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/final-cut-pro/scrolling-timeline.md): Default Shortcut: CONTROL+OPTION+COMMAND+W
- [Shared Pasteboard](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/final-cut-pro/shared-pasteboard-history.md): Shared Pasteboard is another tools that is only available when used with Final Cut Pro.
- [Viewer Overlay](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/final-cut-pro/viewer-overlay.md): The Viewer Overlay feature allows you to add overlays on top of Final Cut Pro's Viewer.
- [Workflow Extension](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/final-cut-pro/workflow-extension.md): The CommandPost Workflow Extension allows CommandPost to control the Final Cut Pro playhead via the Workflow Extensions API.

## Scripting

- [Snippets Library](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/scripting/snippets-library.md): This page contains a collection of useful Lua Snippets organised in alphabetical order.
- [AppleScript](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/scripting/applescript.md): CommandPost allows you to trigger any arbitrary Lua code via CommandPost's AppleScript interface.
- [Command Line Tool](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/scripting/command-line-interface.md): CommandPost offers an optional Command Line Tool, that allows you to trigger any arbitrary Lua code via Apple's Terminal.
- [Snippets for Actions](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/scripting/snippets-for-actions.md): CommandPost allows you to create Lua code snippets, which appear as actions in CommandPost's Search Console.
- [Snippets for Icons](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/scripting/snippets-for-icons.md): The Loupedeck & Stream Deck Preferences panels have the ability to use Lua Snippets to programatically generate icons for the panels with screens.
- [Snippets for LED Colors](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/scripting/snippets-for-led-colors.md): The Loupedeck and Razer Preferences panels have the ability to use Lua Snippets to set what color you want an LED button to use.
- [Snippets for LED Status](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/scripting/snippets-for-led-status.md): The DaVinci Resolve Control Surface panel has the ability to use Lua Snippets to set whether or not an LED is active.
- [URL Handler](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/scripting/url-handler.md): CommandPost has a URL Handler which allows you to trigger CommandPost Commands & Actions via a simple URL address.

## Developer

- [Introduction](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/developer/introduction.md): CommandPost is a free and open source Mac application that adds a mountain-load of new features to Apple’s Final Cut Pro. It originally started off as a little proof of concept project to make finding the browser playhead easier for Scott Simmons.
- [Installation & Setup](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/developer/installation-and-setup.md): If you're interested in modifying CommandPost-App (the Objective-C based "engine" that drives CommandPost), you can follow the instructions below to get setup.
- [Naming Conventions](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/developer/naming-conventions.md): Both Lua and Objective-C portions of an extension/plugin should contain in-line documention of all of the functions they expose to users of the extension/plugin.
- [Memory Management](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/developer/memory-management.md): Here's some useful links about Lua Memory Management:
- [Lua Overview](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/developer/lua-overview.md): What do DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Photoshop Lightroom, Angry Birds, Apache HTTP Server, Apache Traffic Server, the Firefox web browser, MediaWiki, and World of Warcraft all have in common?
- [CommandPost-App](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/developer/commandpost-app.md): CommandPost is made up of two seperate components:
- [CommandPost](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/developer/commandpost.md): CommandPost is made up of two seperate components:
- [Plugin Overview](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/developer/plugins.md): CommandPost has a very easy to use and powerful plugins functionality, and because Lua is quite a simple language to use, it's really easy to throw together your own CommandPost Plugins!
- [Translation](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/developer/translation.md): CommandPost has been designed with internationalisation in mind.

## API References

### CommandPost API

- [CommandPost](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/index.md): Module
- [cp](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.md): Core CommandPost functionality.
- [cp.18n](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.18n.md): CommandPost's Internationalisation & Localisation Manger.
- [cp.adobe.aftereffects](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.adobe.aftereffects.md): Adobe After Effects Extension
- [cp.adobe.aftereffects.app](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.adobe.aftereffects.app.md): The cp.app for Adobe After Effects.
- [cp.adobe.aftereffects.shortcuts](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.adobe.aftereffects.shortcuts.md): Translations between After Effects shortcuts and Hammerspoon-friendly shortcuts.
- [cp.app](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.app.md): This class assists with working with macOS apps. It provides functions for finding, checking the running status, version number, path, and many other values related to an application.
- [cp.app.menu](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.app.menu.md): Represents an app's menu bar, providing multi-lingual access to find and trigger menu items.
- [cp.app.prefs](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.app.prefs.md): Provides access to application preferences, typically stored via NSUserDefaults or CFProperties. To access the preferences, simply pass in the Bundle ID (eg.
- [cp.apple.commandeditor](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.commandeditor.md): Functions to control and manage Apple's Command Editor - used in Final Cut Pro, Motion and Compressor.
- [cp.apple.compressor](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.compressor.md): Represents the Compressor application, providing functions that allow different tasks to be accomplished.
- [cp.apple.compressor.app](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.compressor.app.md): The cp.app for Apple's Compressor.
- [cp.apple.fcpxml](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.fcpxml.md): A collection of tools for handling FCPXML Documents.
- [cp.apple.fcpxml.time](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.fcpxml.time.md): Allows you to convert time string values found in a FCPXML document into Lua objects, that do all the operations using rational numbers.
- [cp.apple.fcpxml.timecode](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.fcpxml.timecode.md): Functions for working with timecode in Final Cut Pro XML. Note that a timecode does not have any concept of a frame rate, so it is simple a structure of hours, minutes, seconds and frames.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.md): Represents the Final Cut Pro application, providing functions that allow different tasks to be accomplished.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.app](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.app.md): The cp.app for Final Cut Pro. Will automatically determine if only the trial version of FCPX is installed and use that instead.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.browser.AppearanceAndFiltering](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.browser.appearanceandfiltering.md): Clip Appearance & Filtering Menu Popover
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.browser.Columns](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.browser.columns.md): Final Cut Pro Browser List View Columns
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.CommandDetail](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.commanddetail.md): This class provides a UI for displaying the details of a command when it is selected on the CommandList.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.CommandEditor](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.commandeditor.md): Command Editor Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.CommandGroups](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.commandgroups.md): Represents the list of Command Groups in the CommandList.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.CommandList](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.commandlist.md): A list of commands available in the CommandEditor.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.Commands](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.commands.md): The list of available commands (depending on search and/or CommandGroup that can be mapped to a keyboard shortcut.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.Commands.Header](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.commands.header.md): The header of the Commands.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.Commands.Row](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.commands.row.md): Commands Row.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.KeyDetail](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.cmd.keydetail.md): This class provides a UI for displaying the details of a key when it is selected on the keyboard layout.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.content.Clip](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.content.clip.md): Represents a clip of media inside FCP.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.export.destinations](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.export.destinations.md): Provides access to the list of Share Destinations configured for the user.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.export.ExportDialog](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.export.exportdialog.md): Export Dialog Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.export.GoToPrompt](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.export.gotoprompt.md): Go To Prompt.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.export.ReplaceAlert](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.export.replacealert.md): Replace Alert
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.export.SaveSheet](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.export.savesheet.md): Save Sheet
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.import.MediaImport](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.import.mediaimport.md): Media Import
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.audio.AudioComponent](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.audio.audiocomponent.md): The Audio Configuration section of the Audio Inspector.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.audio.AudioConfiguration](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.audio.audioconfiguration.md): The Audio Configuration section of the Audio Inspector.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.audio.AudioInspector](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.audio.audioinspector.md): Audio Inspector Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.audio.MainProperties](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.audio.mainproperties.md): The MainProperties UI for the AudioInspector.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.audio.TopProperties](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.audio.topproperties.md): The TopProperties class is used to represent the top properties group of the Audio Inspector.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.BaseMotionPanel](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.basemotionpanel.md): A base class for Inspector panels that publish Motion parameters.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.BasePanel](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.basepanel.md): A base class for the different panels in the Inspector.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ColorAdjustments](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.coloradjustments.md): Color Adjustments Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ColorBoard](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.colorboard.md): Color Board Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ColorBoardAspect](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.colorboardaspect.md): Represents a particular aspect of the color board (Color/Saturation/Exposure).
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ColorCurve](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.colorcurve.md): A ColorCurve Element.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ColorCurves](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.colorcurves.md): Color Curves Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ColorInspector](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.colorinspector.md): Color Inspector Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ColorPuck](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.colorpuck.md): Color ColorPuck Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ColorWell](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.colorwell.md): Represents a single Color Well in the Color Wheels Inspector.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ColorWheel](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.colorwheel.md): Represents a single Color Well in the Color Wheels Inspector.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ColorWheels](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.colorwheels.md): Color Wheels Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.CorrectionsBar](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.correctionsbar.md): The Correction selection/management bar at the top of the ColorInspector.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.HueSaturationCurve](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.huesaturationcurve.md): A HueSaturationCurve Element.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.HueSaturationCurves](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.huesaturationcurves.md): Color Curves Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.ValueIndicator](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.color.valueindicator.md): ValueIndicator Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.generator.GeneratorInspector](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.generator.generatorinspector.md): Generator Inspector Module. This appears for both Generators and Titles.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.info.InfoInspector](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.info.infoinspector.md): Video Inspector Module.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.info.InfoProjectInspector](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.info.infoprojectinspector.md): Info Inspector Module when a Project is selected.
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.Inspector](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.inspector.md): Inspector
- [cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.InspectorProperty](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.apple.finalcutpro.inspector.inspectorproperty.md): InspectorProperty contains helper functions for handling common property types that occur in various Inspectors in FCP.

- [cp.i18n.languageID](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.i18n.languageid.md): As per Apple's documentation, a language ID is a code which identifies either a language used across multiple regions, a dialect from a specific region, or a script used in multiple regions.
- [cp.i18n.localeID](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.i18n.localeid.md): As per Apple's documentation, a locale ID is a code which identifies either a language used across multiple regions, a dialect from a specific region, a script used in multiple regions, or a combination of all three.
- [cp.i18n.region](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.i18n.region.md): Provides the set of ISO 3166-1 region codes and names. The return value can be iterated as a list, or you can find a specific region by either its upper-case two-character code (alpha2), three-character numeric code (numeric3), or English name (name).
- [cp.i18n.script](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.i18n.script.md): Provides the set of ISO 15924 language scripts. The return value can be iterated as a list, or you can find a specific language by either its four-character code (alpha4), three-character numeric code (numeric3), local name, or English name.
- [cp.idle](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.idle.md): This library allows tasks to be queue for execution when the computer has been idle for a specified amount of time. 'Idle' is defined as no keyboard or mouse movement.

- [cp.is](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.is.md): A simple class that lets you test if a value is a particular type. Notes: for best performance, assign the specific checks you want to use to local functions.

- [cp.rx](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.md): Reactive Extensions for Lua.
- [cp.rx.AsyncSubject](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.asyncsubject.md): AsyncSubjects are subjects that produce either no values or a single value. If multiple values are produced via onNext, only the last one is used. If onError is called, then no value is produced and onError is called on any subscribed Observers.
- [cp.rx.BehaviorSubject](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.behaviorsubject.md): A Subject that tracks its current value. Provides an accessor to retrieve the most recent pushed value, and all subscribers immediately receive the latest value.
- [cp.rx.CooperativeScheduler](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.cooperativescheduler.md): Manages Observables using coroutines and a virtual clock that must be updated manually.
- [cp.rx.go](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.md): Defines Statements to make processing of cp.rx.Observable values in ways that are more familiar to synchronous programmers.
- [cp.rx.go.Do](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.do.md): A Statement that will execute the provided resolvable values. This will resolve the provided values into Observables and pass on the first result of each to the next stage as individual parameters.
- [cp.rx.go.Do.Then](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.do.then.md): A Statement.Modifier of Do that defines what happens after the Do values resolve.
- [cp.rx.go.Done](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.done.md): A Statement that will complete without sending any values.
- [cp.rx.go.First](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.first.md): Extends: Statement
- [cp.rx.go.Given](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.given.md): A Statement that will execute the provided resolvable values. This will resolve the provided values into Observables and pass on the first result of each to the next stage as individual parameters.
- [cp.rx.go.Given.Then](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.given.then.md): A Statement.Modifier of Given that defines what happens after the Given values resolve.
- [cp.rx.go.If](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.if.md): A Statement that will check if a resolvable matches a predicate, then executes other resolvables.
- [cp.rx.go.If.Are](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.if.are.md): A [Statement.Modifier] of If that sets the values to match.
- [cp.rx.go.If.AreNot](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.if.arenot.md): A Statement.Modifier for If that sets the values to not match.
- [cp.rx.go.If.Is](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.if.is.md): A Statement.Modifier for If that sets a specific value to match.
- [cp.rx.go.If.IsNot](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.if.isnot.md): A Statement.Modifier for If that sets a specific value to not match.
- [cp.rx.go.If.Matches](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.if.matches.md): A Statement.Modifier for If that sets a predicate check values against.
- [cp.rx.go.If.Then](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.if.then.md): A Statement.Modifier that defines what happens when an If matches.
- [cp.rx.go.If.Then.Otherwise](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.if.then.otherwise.md): A Statement.Modifier of If, which should be created via If:Then(...):Otherwise(...).
- [cp.rx.go.If.Then.Otherwise.Then](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.if.then.otherwise.then.md): Each Otherwise can have a subsequent Then which will be executed after the previous one resolves.
- [cp.rx.go.Last](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.last.md): A Statement that will complete after the only the last result resolves.
- [cp.rx.go.List](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.list.md): Extends: Statement
- [cp.rx.go.List.Sorted](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.list.sorted.md): A Statement.Modifier that specifies the list should be sorted by its 'natural' order - that is a b.
- [cp.rx.go.List.SortedBy](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.list.sortedby.md): A Statement.Modifier that specifies the list should be sorted by the specified function.
- [cp.rx.go.Require](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.require.md): A Statement that will require that the resolvable value matches a predicate, and if not, it will send an error.
- [cp.rx.go.Require.Are](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.require.are.md): Specifies that the Required values Are a specific value.
- [cp.rx.go.Require.AreNot](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.require.arenot.md): Specifies that the Required values AreNot a specific value.
- [cp.rx.go.Require.Is](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.require.is.md): Specifies that the Required value Is a specific value.
- [cp.rx.go.Require.IsNot](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.require.isnot.md): Specifies that the Required value IsNot a specific value.
- [cp.rx.go.Require.Matches](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.require.matches.md): Specifies that the Required value Matches a function predicate.
- [cp.rx.go.Retry](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.retry.md): Extends: Statement
- [cp.rx.go.SetProp](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.setprop.md): A Statement that will update a cp.prop value, then optionally execute other resolvables, and optionally reset the cp.prop to its previous value. This is
- [cp.rx.go.SetProp.To](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.setprop.to.md): A Statement.Modifier that defines what value to set a cp.prop to.
- [cp.rx.go.SetProp.To.Then](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.setprop.to.then.md): A Statement.Modifier that defines what happens when after SetProp.To is executed.
- [cp.rx.go.SetProp.To.Then.ThenReset](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.setprop.to.then.thenreset.md): A Statement.Modifier that specifies that the cp.prop is reset to its original value once execution completes.
- [cp.rx.go.Statement](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.statement.md): A Statement is defined to enable processing of asynchronous resolvable values such as cp.rx.Observable values.
- [cp.rx.go.Statement.Definition](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.statement.definition.md): A Statement is defined before being executable. A definition is initiated with the Statement:modifier(...) method.
- [cp.rx.go.Statement.Modifier](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.statement.modifier.md): A Statement.Modifier is an extension to a Statement that provides additional configuration details. They are initiated via the modifier method of a defined Statement.
- [cp.rx.go.Statement.Modifier.Definition](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.statement.modifier.definition.md): A Statement.Modifier is defined before being executable. It is an extension of Statement.Definition and inherits all of it's methods also.
- [cp.rx.go.Throw](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.throw.md): A Statement that will throw the provided message.
- [cp.rx.go.WaitUntil](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.go.waituntil.md): A Statement that will wait for the first value from a resolveable that matches the predicate.
- [cp.rx.ImmediateScheduler](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.immediatescheduler.md): Schedules Observables by running all operations immediately.
- [cp.rx.Observable](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.observable.md): Observables push values to Observers.
- [cp.rx.Observer](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.observer.md): Observers are simple objects that receive values from Observables.
- [cp.rx.Reference](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.reference.md): A handle representing the link between an Observer and an Observable, as well as any work required to clean up after the Observable completes or the Observer cancels.
- [cp.rx.RelaySubject](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.relaysubject.md): A Subject that provides new Observers with some or all of the most recently produced values upon reference.
- [cp.rx.Subject](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.subject.md): Subjects function both as an Observer and as an Observable. Subjects inherit all Observable functions, including subscribe. Values can also be pushed to the Subject, which will be broadcasted to any subscribed Observers.
- [cp.rx.TimeoutScheduler](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.rx.timeoutscheduler.md): A scheduler that uses the hs.timer library to schedule events on an event loop.
- [cp.sourcewatcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.sourcewatcher.md): Watches folders for specific file extensions and reloads the app if they change.
- [cp.spec](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.md): An synchronous/asynchronous test library for Lua.
- [cp.spec.DefaultHandler](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.defaulthandler.md): Default implementation of Handler, which outputs via the standard print function.
- [cp.spec.Definition](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.definition.md): A Definition is a superclass for a "runnable" specification. It doesn't do anything itself, but provides a common ancestor for all implementation classes like Specification and Scenario.
- [cp.spec.Error](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.error.md): Provides an Error message, which can be thrown via the error function.
- [cp.spec.expect](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.expect.md): Provides a way of checking values match expected results. At it's core, it uses assert to make the check.
- [cp.spec.Handled](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.handled.md): An synchronous/asynchronous test library for Lua.
- [cp.spec.Handler](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.handler.md): Subclasses of this can customise how reports are handled. All methods do nothing.
- [cp.spec.Message](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.message.md): Provides an Message message, which can be thrown via the error function.
- [cp.spec.Report](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.report.md): The results of a test run.
- [cp.spec.Run](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.run.md): An individual run of a test Definition or Specification.
- [cp.spec.Run.This](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.run.this.md): A token passed to test functions to allow them to indicate if a test run will complete asynchronously.
- [cp.spec.Scenario](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.scenario.md): A Definition which describes a specific scenario.
- [cp.spec.Specification](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.specification.md): A Specification is a list of definitions which will be run in sequence, and the results are collated. It is often created via the describe function.
- [cp.spec.TestCase](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.testcase.md): Wraps cp.test into a subclass of Scenario.
- [cp.spec.TestSuite](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.testsuite.md): Test Suite.
- [cp.spec.Where](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.spec.where.md): Created via Scenario:where(...).
- [cp.strings](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.strings.md): Provides strings from (potentially) multiple sources, with support for loading from multiple languages.
- [cp.strings.source.plist](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.strings.source.plist.md): Loads strings from a plist with allowing for a given language variation. Eg:
- [cp.strings.source.table](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.strings.source.table.md): Loads strings from provided tables, allowing for a given language variation. Eg:
- [cp.test](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.test.md): CommandPost Test Scripts.
- [cp.text](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.text.md): This module provides support for loading, manipulating, and comparing unicode text data. It works by storing characters with their Unicode 'codepointvalue.
- [cp.text.matcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.text.matcher.md): Adapted from 'utf8.lua' (https://github.com/Stepets/utf8.lua)
- [cp.time.flicks](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.time.flicks.md): Provides support for measuring time in flicks, a base unit of time useful for working with media, such as video or audio files.
- [cp.tools](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.tools.md): A collection of handy miscellaneous tools for Lua development.

- [cp.websocket.status](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/commandpost/cp.websocket.status.md): A table of statuses used by both cp.websocket.serial and cp.websocket.http to describe the connection status.

### Hammerspoon API

- [CommandPost](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/index.md): Module
- [hs](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.md): Core Hammerspoon functionality
- [hs.alert](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.alert.md): Simple on-screen alerts
- [hs.appfinder](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.appfinder.md): Easily find hs.application and hs.window objects
- [hs.applescript](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.applescript.md): Execute AppleScript code
- [hs.application](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.application.md): Manipulate running applications
- [hs.application.watcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.application.watcher.md): Watch for application launch/terminate events
- [hs.audiodevice](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.audiodevice.md): Manipulate the system's audio devices
- [hs.audiodevice.datasource](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.audiodevice.datasource.md): Inspect/manipulate the data sources of an audio device
- [hs.audiodevice.watcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.audiodevice.watcher.md): Watch for system level audio hardware events
- [hs.axuielement](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.axuielement.md): This module allows you to access the accessibility objects of running applications, their windows, menus, and other user interface elements that support the OS X accessibility API.
- [hs.axuielement.axtextmarker](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.axuielement.axtextmarker.md): This submodule allows hs.axuielement to support using AXTextMarker and AXTextMarkerRange objects as parameters for parameterized Accessibility attributes with applications that support them.
- [hs.axuielement.observer](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.axuielement.observer.md): This submodule allows you to create observers for accessibility elements and be notified when they trigger notifications. Not all notifications are
- [hs.base64](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.base64.md): Base64 encoding and decoding
- [hs.battery](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.battery.md): Battery/power information All functions here may return nil, if the information requested is not available.
- [hs.battery.watcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.battery.watcher.md): Watch for battery/power state changes
- [hs.blackmagic](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.blackmagic.md): Support for the Blackmagic DaVinci Resolve Speed Editor Keyboard and Editor Keyboard.
- [hs.bonjour](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.bonjour.md): Find and publish network services advertised by multicast DNS (Bonjour) with Hammerspoon.
- [hs.bonjour.service](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.bonjour.service.md): Represents the service records that are discovered or published by the hs.bonjour module.
- [hs.brightness](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.brightness.md): Inspect/manipulate display brightness
- [hs.caffeinate](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.caffeinate.md): Control system power states (sleeping, preventing sleep, screen locking, etc)
- [hs.caffeinate.watcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.caffeinate.watcher.md): Watch for display and system sleep/wake/power events and for fast user switching session events.
- [hs.camera](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.camera.md): Inspect the system's camera devices
- [hs.canvas](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.canvas.md): A different approach to drawing in Hammerspoon
- [hs.canvas.matrix](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.canvas.matrix.md): A sub module to hs.canvas which provides support for basic matrix manipulations which can be used as the values for transformation attributes in the hs.canvas module.
- [hs.chooser](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.chooser.md): Graphical, interactive tool for choosing/searching data
- [hs.console](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.console.md): Some functions for manipulating the Hammerspoon console.
- [hs.crash](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.crash.md): Various features/facilities for developers who are working on Hammerspoon itself, or writing extensions for it. It is extremely unlikely that you should need any part of this extension, in a normal user configuration.
- [hs.deezer](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.deezer.md): Controls for Deezer music player.
- [hs.dialog](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.dialog.md): A collection of useful dialog boxes, alerts and panels for user interaction.
- [hs.dialog.color](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.dialog.color.md): A panel that allows users to select a color.
- [hs.distributednotifications](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.distributednotifications.md): Interact with NSDistributedNotificationCenter There are many notifications posted by parts of OS X, and third party apps, which may be interesting to react to using this module.
- [hs.doc](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.doc.md): Create documentation objects for interactive help within Hammerspoon
- [hs.doc.builder](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.doc.builder.md): Builds documentation support files. Still experimental.
- [hs.doc.hsdocs](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.doc.hsdocs.md): Manage the internal documentation web server.

- [hs.dockicon](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.dockicon.md): Control Hammerspoon's dock icon
- [hs.drawing](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.drawing.md): DEPRECATED. Primitives for drawing on the screen in various ways.
- [hs.drawing.color](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.drawing.color.md): Provides access to the system color lists and a wider variety of ways to represent color within Hammerspoon.
- [hs.eventtap](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.eventtap.md): Tap into input events (mouse, keyboard, trackpad) for observation and possibly overriding them It also provides convenience wrappers for sending mouse and keyboard events.
- [hs.eventtap.event](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.eventtap.event.md): Create, modify and inspect events for hs.eventtap

- [hs.fs](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.fs.md): Access/inspect the filesystem
- [hs.fs.volume](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.fs.volume.md): Interact with OS X filesystem volumes

- [hs.hid](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.hid.md): HID interface for Hammerspoon, controls and queries caps lock state
- [hs.hid.led](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.hid.led.md): HID LED interface for Hammerspoon, controls the state of keyboard LEDs

- [hs.host.locale](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.host.locale.md): Retrieve information about the user's Language and Region settings.

- [hs.hotkey.modal](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.hotkey.modal.md): Create/manage modal keyboard shortcut environments
- [hs.http](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.http.md): Perform HTTP requests
- [hs.httpserver](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.httpserver.md): Simple HTTP server
- [hs.httpserver.hsminweb](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.httpserver.hsminweb.md): Minimalist Web Server for Hammerspoon
- [hs.httpserver.hsminweb.cgilua](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.httpserver.hsminweb.cgilua.md): Provides support functions in the cgilua module for Hammerspoon Minimal Web Server Lua templates.
- [hs.httpserver.hsminweb.cgilua.lp](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.httpserver.hsminweb.cgilua.lp.md): Support functions for the CGILua compatibility module for including and translating Lua template pages into Lua code for execution within the Hammerspoon environment to provide dynamic content for http requests.
- [hs.httpserver.hsminweb.cgilua.urlcode](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.httpserver.hsminweb.cgilua.urlcode.md): Support functions for the CGILua compatibility module for encoding and decoding URL components in accordance with RFC 3986.

- [hs.inspect](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.inspect.md): Produce human-readable representations of Lua variables (particularly tables)
- [hs.ipc](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.ipc.md): Provides Hammerspoon with the ability to create both local and remote message ports for inter-process communication.
- [hs.itunes](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.itunes.md): Controls for iTunes music player
- [hs.javascript](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.javascript.md): Execute JavaScript code
- [hs.json](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.json.md): JSON encoding and decoding
- [hs.keycodes](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.keycodes.md): Convert between key-strings and key-codes. Also provides functionality for querying and changing keyboard layouts.
- [hs.layout](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.layout.md): Window layout manager
- [hs.location](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.location.md): Determine the machine's location and useful information about that location
- [hs.location.geocoder](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.location.geocoder.md): Converts between GPS coordinates and more user friendly representations like an address or points of interest.

- [hs.midi](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.midi.md): MIDI Extension for Hammerspoon.
- [hs.milight](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.milight.md): Simple controls for the MiLight LED WiFi bridge (also known as LimitlessLED and EasyBulb)
- [hs.mjomatic](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.mjomatic.md): tmuxomatic-like window management
- [hs.mouse](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.mouse.md): Inspect/manipulate the position of the mouse pointer
- [hs.network](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.network.md): This module provides functions for inquiring about and monitoring changes to the network.
- [hs.network.configuration](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.network.configuration.md): This sub-module provides access to the current location set configuration settings in the system's dynamic store.
- [hs.network.host](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.network.host.md): This sub-module provides functions for acquiring host information, such as hostnames, addresses, and reachability.
- [hs.network.ping](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.network.ping.md): This module provides a basic ping function which can test host availability. Ping is a network diagnostic tool commonly found in most operating systems which can be used to test if a route to a specified host exists and if that host is responding to network traffic.
- [hs.network.ping.echoRequest](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.network.ping.echorequest.md): Provides lower-level access to the ICMP Echo Request infrastructure used by the hs.network.ping module. In general, you should not need to use this module directly unless you have specific requirements not met by the hs.network.ping module and the hs.network.ping object methods.
- [hs.network.reachability](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.network.reachability.md): This sub-module can be used to determine the reachability of a target host. A remote host is considered reachable when a data packet, sent by an application into the network stack, can leave the local device.
- [hs.noises](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.noises.md): Contains two low latency audio recognizers for different mouth noises, which can be used to trigger actions like scrolling or clicking. The recognizers are also high accuracy and don't use much CPU time.
- [hs.notify](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.notify.md): This module allows you to create on screen notifications in the User Notification Center located at the right of the users screen.
- [hs.osascript](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.osascript.md): Execute Open Scripting Architecture (OSA) code - AppleScript and JavaScript
- [hs.osc](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.osc.md): Open Sound Control (OSC) support.
- [hs.pasteboard](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.pasteboard.md): Inspect/manipulate pasteboards (more commonly called clipboards). Both the system default pasteboard and custom named pasteboards can be interacted with.
- [hs.pasteboard.watcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.pasteboard.watcher.md): Watch for Pasteboard Changes. macOS doesn't offer any API for getting Pasteboard notifications, so this extension uses polling to check for Pasteboard changes at a chosen interval (defaults to 0.25).
- [hs.pathwatcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.pathwatcher.md): Watch paths recursively for changes
- [hs.plist](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.plist.md): Read and write Property List files
- [hs.razer](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.razer.md): Razer device support.
- [hs.redshift](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.redshift.md): Inverts and/or lowers the color temperature of the screen(s) on a schedule, for a more pleasant experience at night
- [hs.screen](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.screen.md): Manipulate screens (i.e. monitors)
- [hs.screen.watcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.screen.watcher.md): Watch for screen layout changes This could be the addition or removal of a monitor, a screen resolution change, movement of a monitor in the Display preferences pane, etc.
- [hs.serial](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.serial.md): Communicate with external devices through a serial port (most commonly RS-232).
- [hs.settings](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.settings.md): Serialize simple Lua variables across Hammerspoon launches Settings must have a string key and must be made up of serializable Lua objects (string, number,
- [hs.sharing](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.sharing.md): Share items with the macOS Sharing Services under the control of Hammerspoon.
- [hs.shortcuts](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.shortcuts.md): List and run shortcuts from the Shortcuts app
- [hs.socket](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.socket.md): Talk to custom protocols using asynchronous TCP sockets.
- [hs.socket.udp](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.socket.udp.md): Talk to custom protocols using asynchronous UDP sockets.
- [hs.sound](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.sound.md): Load/play/manipulate sound files
- [hs.spaces](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.spaces.md): This module provides some basic functions for controlling macOS Spaces.
- [hs.spaces.watcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.spaces.watcher.md): Watches for the current Space being changed NOTE: This extension determines the number of a Space, using OS X APIs that have been deprecated since 10.8 and will likely be removed in a future release.
- [hs.speech](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.speech.md): This module provides access to the Speech Synthesizer component of OS X.
- [hs.speech.listener](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.speech.listener.md): This module provides access to the Speech Recognizer component of OS X.
- [hs.spoons](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.spoons.md): Utility and management functions for Spoons Spoons are Lua plugins for Hammerspoon. See https://www.hammerspoon.org/Spoons/ for more information
- [hs.spotify](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.spotify.md): Controls for Spotify music player
- [hs.spotlight](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.spotlight.md): This module allows Hammerspoon to preform Spotlight metadata queries.
- [hs.spotlight.group](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.spotlight.group.md): This sub-module is used to access results to a spotlightObject query which have been grouped by one or more attribute values.
- [hs.spotlight.item](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.spotlight.item.md): This sub-module is used to access the individual results of a spotlightObject or a spotlightGroupObject.
- [hs.sqlite3](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.sqlite3.md): Interact with SQLite databases
- [hs.streamdeck](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.streamdeck.md): Configure/control an Elgato Stream Deck.
- [hs.styledtext](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.styledtext.md): This module adds support for controlling the style of the text in Hammerspoon.
- [hs.tabs](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.tabs.md): Place the windows of an application into tabs drawn on its titlebar
- [hs.tangent](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.tangent.md): Tangent Control Surface Extension
- [hs.task](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.task.md): Execute processes in the background and capture their output
- [hs.timer](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.timer.md): Execute functions with various timing rules
- [hs.timer.delayed](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.timer.delayed.md): Specialized timer objects to coalesce processing of unpredictable asynchronous events into a single callback
- [hs.uielement](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.uielement.md): A generalized framework for working with OSX UI elements
- [hs.uielement.watcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.uielement.watcher.md): Watch for events on certain UI elements (including windows and applications)
- [hs.urlevent](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.urlevent.md): Allows CommandPost to respond to URLs CommandPost is configured to react to URLs that start with commandpost:// when they are opened by OS X. This extension allows you to register callbacks for these URL events and their parameters, offering a flexible way to receive events from other applications.
- [hs.usb](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.usb.md): Inspect USB devices
- [hs.usb.watcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.usb.watcher.md): Watch for USB device connection/disconnection events
- [hs.utf8](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.utf8.md): Functions providing basic support for UTF-8 encodings
- [hs.vox](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.vox.md): Controls for VOX music player
- [hs.watchable](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.watchable.md): A minimalistic Key-Value-Observer framework for Lua.
- [hs.websocket](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.websocket.md): Simple websocket client.
- [hs.webview](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.webview.md): Display web content in a window from Hammerspoon
- [hs.webview.datastore](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.webview.datastore.md): Provides methods to list and purge the various types of data used by websites visited with hs.webview.
- [hs.webview.toolbar](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.webview.toolbar.md): Create and manipulate toolbars which can be attached to the Hammerspoon console or hs.webview objects.
- [hs.webview.usercontent](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.webview.usercontent.md): This module provides support for injecting custom JavaScript user content into your webviews and for JavaScript to post messages back to Hammerspoon.
- [hs.wifi](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.wifi.md): Inspect WiFi networks
- [hs.wifi.watcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.wifi.watcher.md): Watch for changes to the associated wifi network
- [hs.window](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.window.md): Inspect/manipulate windows
- [hs.window.filter](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.window.filter.md): Filter windows by application, title, location on screen and more, and easily subscribe to events on these windows
- [hs.window.highlight](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.window.highlight.md): Highlight the focused window
- [hs.window.layout](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.window.layout.md): WARNING: EXPERIMENTAL MODULE. DO NOT USE IN PRODUCTION. This module is for testing purposes only. It can undergo breaking API changes or go away entirely at any point and without notice.
- [hs.window.switcher](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.window.switcher.md): Window-based cmd-tab replacement
- [hs.window.tiling](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/hammerspoon/hs.window.tiling.md): WARNING: EXPERIMENTAL MODULE. DO NOT USE IN PRODUCTION. This module is for testing purposes only. It can undergo breaking API changes or go away entirely at any point and without notice.

### Plugins API

- [CommandPost](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/index.md): Module
- [plugins.aftereffects.application.manager](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.aftereffects.application.manager.md): Registers After Effects with the Core Application Manager if installed.
- [plugins.aftereffects.effects](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.aftereffects.effects.md): Apply an After Effect effect to selected layer
- [plugins.aftereffects.preferences](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.aftereffects.preferences.md): After Effects Preferences Panel
- [plugins.aftereffects.shortcuts](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.aftereffects.shortcuts.md): Trigger After Effects Shortcuts
- [plugins.aftereffects.tangent.manager](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.aftereffects.tangent.manager.md): Manager for After Effects Tangent Support
- [plugins.compressor.application.manager](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.compressor.application.manager.md): Registers Compressor with the Core Application Manager.
- [plugins.compressor.feedback.bugreport](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.compressor.feedback.bugreport.md): Sends Apple a Bug Report or Feature Request for Compressor.
- [plugins.core.accessibility](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.core.accessibility.md): Accessibility Plugin.
- [plugins.core.accessibility.screenrecording](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.core.accessibility.screenrecording.md): Screen Recording Permission.
- [plugins.core.accessibility.tools](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.core.accessibility.tools.md): Actions for control user interface elements via the Accessibility API.
- [plugins.core.action.activator](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.core.action.activator.md): This module provides provides a way of activating choices provided by action handlers. It also provide support for making a particular action a favourite, returning results based on popularity, and completely hiding particular actions, or categories of action.
- [plugins.core.action.handler](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.core.action.handler.md): A support class for handler handlers. It is not used directly, rather it is a 'super class' that provides common functionality.
- [plugins.core.action.manager](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.core.action.manager.md): Action Manager Module.
- [plugins.core.actions.custom](https://commandpost.fcp.cafe/api-references/plugins/plugins.core.actions.custom.md): Creates a bunch of commands that can be used to assign actions to. This allows you to assign any action to a shortcut key in CommandPost.
